claire_sales: Quick thread 52 Prospect: MeridianTrust wants BYO-KMS (HSM) for POC. They52ll run an HSM gateway behind a corporate outbound proxy. Need: exact egress matrix, pen-test window availability, rotation coordination, and a short POC quote.

ivan_eng: We can run our keybroker as a sidecar or as a small managed connector in their VPC. Requirements: outbound TLS on 443 to their endpoint(s). If their proxy terminates TLS we need TCP passthrough or a way to forward client certs; otherwise mTLS won't work.

diego_ops: Network details: allow outbound 443 to these CIDR ranges and FQDNs (they'll provide). Intercepting proxies typically add +20-100ms; depends on HSM RTT. If they need tight p95 latency consider Dedicated routing or colocated gateway.

rachel_sec: For the security questionnaire ask for HSM vendor/model, proof of FIPS 140-2/3 or equivalent attestation, whether keys are exportable, key operator SOPs, rotation trigger and cadence, and SOC2 Type II. Also confirm keys never leave the HSM in plaintext and request HSM firmware patch policy.

claire_sales: They proposed a pen-test week of 2026-08-10. Can infra support?

diego_ops: Pen-test OK with 72h scope notice, authorized test IPs, and a preflight checklist. We require non-destructive tests and an on-call contact during the window. deploy-bot: preflight checklist link: https://redwood.internal/pen-test-preflight

leo_se: Pricing/quote: BYO-KMS add-on = integration fee + per-unwrap routing fee + optional reserved capacity for Dedicated routing. For POCs we often waive the integration fee if they convert to a paid pilot. Need expected unwraps/sec and audit log retention (90/180/365d) to finalise numbers.

claire_sales: MeridianTrust estimates 300 unwraps/sec burst, 25k/day avg, logs 180d. They want a POC price and a note about rotation window requirements.

leo_se: Ballpark POC: integration fee waived with conversion, ops/routing add-on ~$3.5k/mo + $0.0018 per unwrap, storage delta for 180d logs adds ~$400/mo. Recommend Dedicated routing line item for stable latency. I'll put formal numbers in the quote doc.

ivan_eng: POC plan: run connector in their VPC via private link. We'll provide a small harness to emulate unwraps. Example wrk command to stress test and capture latency profile:

```
rwk -t12 -c400 -d60s https://staging-hsm.meridian.internal/unwrap
```

We also need tcpdump/TLS trace on the gateway to confirm client cert passthrough.

rachel_sec: Rotation/ops note: if Meridian wants coordinated key rotation we need a 90-minute maintenance window for in-place swap to avoid failures; if they prefer blue/green swap it's shorter but requires both keys available simultaneously. Request attestation artifact before any production cutover.

claire_sales: Action items: 1) @rachel_sec draft and send short Q list now, 2) @leo_se draft POC quote with Dedicated option and storage delta, 3) @ivan_eng prepare sidecar runbook + wrk harness and TLS debug steps, 4) @diego_ops prepare pen-test preflight + IP list. I'll schedule a 30m sync with Meridian tomorrow.

deploy-bot: FYI: BYO-KMS runbook updated: https://redwood.internal/byo-kms-guidelines (attestation required before prod).

claire_sales: Thanks team. Sending the Qs in 25m unless blockers. :thumbsup:
